text: This is SyteNav: one place to run your construction jobs, from the first quote to the final invoice.
The dashboard shows every active job, what's due today, and what needs your attention.
Open a project, like Maple Street Residences. Everything for this job lives under one header.
The menu is grouped the way a job runs: Field, Buyout, Finance, and Docs.
The schedule lays out each trade on a timeline, linked to the trade it waits on.
Move one date, and SyteNav shows who else shifts before anything is saved, or anyone is told.
Daily logs capture weather, crew, and photos from the site, so the record writes itself.
Inspections count down to the visit, and warn the field crew two business days ahead.
The budget compares what you estimated with what you've committed and spent, line by line.
Bills from subs arrive waiting for approval. Nothing is paid, or pushed anywhere, until a person says yes.
On the other side, Billing the client tracks what you've invoiced and what's been paid.
Change orders keep scope changes and their cost in writing, before the work is done.
Connect QuickBooks Online, and approved invoices, bills, and payments flow over automatically.
Share a private portal link, so your client sees progress and invoices without another phone call.
SyteNav. Less chasing, fewer leaks, and every job in one place.
